purpose: Explain slow monotonic drift in one vehicle's numeric telemetry history using Theil-Sen magnitude, tie-aware Mann-Kendall significance and an evidence-limited forecast.
primaryGoal: Choose a recorded signal, distinguish drift from noise, assess sample coverage and inspect historical values, robust baseline and forecast uncertainty without confusing this analysis with anomalies, change points or correlation.

dataSources.source: Signal handler's available catalog; hook normalizes rich catalog entries to names.
dataSources.behavior: Enabled only for a positive vehicle ID; standard stale time; safe-array normalization; cancellation signal forwarded. Names are offered without filtering numeric value kinds or retaining unit-kind metadata.

dataSources.source: History handler route; backend query completeness, ordering, storage fallback and actual returned bounds were not inspected.
dataSources.behavior: Positive vehicle ID and nonempty signal enable the query; bounded hours and limit are query-key inputs; moderate stale time; standard polling with background polling disabled; cancellation forwarded. Statistical analysis only covers returned numeric samples. Optional from/to are disclosed by the brief, not fabricated.

dataSources.source: Pure local analysis of retained history, not another backend or measurement source.
dataSources.behavior: Finite numeric kinds with valid timestamps only; enum, text and boolean values excluded; sort and last-valid timestamp deduplication; robust pairwise slope capped to 300 comparison samples; tie-aware significance; MAD residual spread. Forecast requires at least eight samples, six observed hours and significant ordering; default horizon is min(24h, observed span), step at least 2h.

issues.rule: MDC-026; unknown is not measured non-significance
issues.detail: hasData means only samples>0. A single sample produces mannKendall=null in signalTrend.ts:262, yet the metric says Not significant and interpretation says observed ordering does not clear the bar (260-267). For evidence-limited histories the statistical conclusion needs a clear qualification; no test result is not a negative test result.
issues.fix: Present unavailable/not-tested significance when Mann-Kendall is null; qualify evidence-limited results without changing the statistical model, thresholds or available tau/p values. Preserve both interpretation cards.

issues.detail: The always-created sample description substitutes summary.spanHours??0 even when there is no numeric history and spanHours is null. This supplies a synthetic 0h context to the brief; downstream visible loading/unknown suppression was not inspected.
issues.fix: Keep span unknown until measured and use the shared formatter's missing representation or localized unknown context; retain genuine single-sample zero span and resolved zero sample count.
issues.confidence: high for provided value; rendered exposure unverified

visualIssues.detail: Fixed cyan-300 title icons recur at line 244 despite no semantic cyan distinction. These are decorative accents rather than explicit neon/glow. No literal neon, glow or pure-white class occurs in this page. Chart lines use shared blue/green and translucent amber tokens, not a local rainbow; rendered saturation/contrast is unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer neutral theme-aware decorative-icon tokens; retain meaningful actual/baseline/forecast distinctions and saved chart/theme choices. Do not force-reset preferences or invent a page palette.

visualIssues.detail: Axis ticks prescribe 10px and 11px rather than a shared typography scale. Readability at mobile widths, text zoom and light theme is unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing shared chart typography policy and validate labels at narrow allocated widths and enlarged text; preserve labels, axes and full fallback data.

architectureIssues.detail: Both forecast Areas read hidden.isHidden('forecast'), but ChartLegend resolves its visible band identity from dataKey='bandRange' (ChartLegend.tsx:40-49,72-79). A legend click therefore stores bandRange while the plotted Areas consult forecast. Baseline and actual identities match. This is a source-confirmed inconsistent toggle path, not a browser reproduction.
architectureIssues.fix: Adapt the existing legend state at the page boundary so bandRange maps to the existing forecast group and both band Areas toggle together; preserve signal-trend-forecast and existing hidden_forecast URL state instead of silently renaming persisted keys.

architectureIssues.detail: Analysis is fixed to 168h and consumes no workspace range. /signal-trend is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (workspaceScope.ts:23-77). The analysis hook only accepts hours/limit (useTelemetry.ts:194-222). This is a dated analytical page without the canonical workspace range integration.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate route registration and a typed history-hook bounds contract with the shared owner; then consume the existing workspace range and send both server bounds. Keep 168h as the current preservation baseline until equivalence is verified; do not add a local picker or client-filter an already truncated history.

architectureIssues.detail: Chart time strings use browser-default toLocaleString(undefined) and omit explicit saved locale/timezone. Numeric metrics already use the preference-aware useNumberFormatting. Epoch ms is retained internally but fallback/export-facing time is only month/day/hour.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing application date formatter with saved locale/timezone, retaining an unambiguous full timestamp for accessible/export context and the compact axis presentation. Do not change sample epochs or statistical calculations.
